description: This PHP file is a Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing leave request comments and related entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for searching, counting, and saving leave request comments and leave comments, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing leave request comments and leave comments, providing search, count, and save operations.

methods.name: searchLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Queries leave request comments based on filter parameters and returns an array of results.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveRequestCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave request comments matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveRequestCommentPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a Doctrine Paginator object based on filter parameters for leave request comments.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Persists a new or updated LeaveRequestComment entity to the database.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a LeaveRequest entity by its ID (deprecated).

methods.name: searchLeaveComments
methods.description: Queries leave comments based on filter parameters and returns an array of results.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave comments matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveCommentPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a Doctrine Paginator object for leave comments based on filter parameters.

methods.name: saveLeaveComment
methods.description: Persists a new or updated LeaveComment entity to the database.

methods.name: getLeaveById
methods.description: Retrieves a Leave entity by its ID (deprecated).
